review_evidence: A complete proposition scan found 4,764 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across 321 current-primary files.

The retained tree spans cryptographic foundations, Fiat–Shamir, program logics, oracle computations, lattice cryptography, hash signatures, verified external-algorithm bridges, and theorem-rich examples such as ElGamal, Schnorr, Pedersen, PIR, Regev, and PRF reductions.
Import roots, tests, widgets, and interoperability modules are intertwined with the formal interfaces and no source-local lossless hard-exclusion class was established in this review.
summary: Reviewed VCVio and retain all 471 current-primary files as a large cryptographic/program-logic formalization and verification corpus.

review_evidence: Unit contains 932 files (re-review; prior review RRV-9ff20f256cb0-r1 retained all 471 then-current files).

39 of the 44 no-keyword files are pure-import aggregator/umbrella modules (module + public import lines + doc comment, no declarations of their own) at every granularity from single-subtree facades (e.g. VCVio/OracleComp/Coercions/Add.lean, ProgramLogic/Tactics/Common.lean, VCVio/EvalDist/PFunctorSupport.lean) up to whole-package roots (VCVio.lean re-exporting all 417 files under VCVio/, VCVioTest.lean, ToMathlib.lean, LatticeCrypto.lean, HashSig.lean, Interop.lean, VCVioCslib.lean, VCVioWidgets.lean, LatticeCryptoTest.lean, VCVioComplexity/VCVioComplexityTest.lean) -- retained under FILTER-007 as navigation data with import edges, module identity, and documentation comments intact.

5 of the 44 files are opaque/@[extern] FFI declarations to C reference implementations (Extern/Falcon/FFI.lean: 6 Falcon/FN-DSA declarations; Extern/Hashing.lean: 4 SHA-3/SHAKE declarations; Extern/MLDSA/FFI.lean: 9 ML-DSA declarations across 3 parameter sets) or FFI-adjacent bridge/aggregator files (Extern/Falcon/FPRBridge.lean, Extern.lean) -- real formal interface content the grep's keyword list does not cover (`opaque` is not among the 10 grepped keywords).

1 file (CryptoFoundations/FiatShamir/Sigma/Stateful/SimpAttr.lean) is a `register_simp_attr` attribute-registration file; 1 file (VCVio/Prelude/Core.lean) additionally holds `declare_aesop_rule_sets` and `register_simp_attr` commands -- both real formal commands the grep misses, outside the FILTER-007 pure-import class by name but still legitimate non-junk content under default-retain.

3 files are genuine tactic-implementation modules the grep misses because they use `syntax`/`elab_rules`/`meta import` rather than the grepped keywords: ProgramLogic/Tactics/Handler.lean defines and elaborates the `handler_step` tactic; ProgramLogic/Tactics/Relational/Internals.lean and Unary/Internals.lean are `public meta import` aggregators for the VCGen tactic-implementation subtree.

5 files under scripts/ are genuine test fixtures for the AxiomSweep/InitSweep lint tools, using `opaque`/`initialize` declarations (also outside the grepped keyword list) to exercise the gates: Tainted.lean and Unimported.lean instantiate `sorryAx`-taint scenarios (opaque hiddenSorry : Nat := sorryAx Nat true); Clean.lean, Hazard/Initialize.lean, and StaticImport.lean instantiate `initialize ... <- ...` side-effect scenarios the InitSweep gate must correctly classify.

1 file (VCVioComplexity/lakefile.lean) is a Lake build-configuration file (package/require/lean_lib declarations) -- genuine Lean-syntax dependency/build documentation for the VCVioComplexity nested package, not theorem content, but useful navigational metadata analogous to FILTER-007's treatment of import aggregators; no FILTER-004 condition is met (it is not a format-aware proof of zero formal content plus retained navigation elsewhere, nor an exact duplicate of another indexed document), so it stays retained under FILTER-002's default.

third_party/hax-cbd/proofs/lean/extraction/hax_cbd.lean read in full: a genuine Hax-extracted Rust-to-Lean `@[spec] def sample_cbd1` definition, not a vendored/third-party copy despite the path name -- confirms path names alone are not exclusion evidence.

Directory spot-checks of general (non-no-keyword-list) content in every top-level directory not otherwise sampled: HashSigTest/ModuleAPI/FinalValidity.lean (real `example`/`theorem` SLH-DSA conversion proof), VCVioTest/Asymptotics/Negligible.lean (real `theorem superpolynomialDecay_half_pow`), VCVioComplexity/VCVioComplexity/Asymptotics/PolyBound.lean (real `def`/structure PolyBound formalization), VCVioWidgets/Component/RevealLocation.lean (real `structure RevealLocationProps` and `def RevealLocation` widget component), LatticeCrypto/DiscreteGaussian.lean (real discrete Gaussian distribution definitions), LatticeCryptoTest/ArithmeticInstances.lean (real `example`/DecidableEq instance checks), ToMathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Finset.lean (real `lemma sum_update_succ_count`) -- all confirmed genuine mathematical/formal content.

Byte-size extremes checked via wc -c across the 44 no-keyword files (total 84802 bytes, largest VCVio.lean at 24378 bytes) and across the whole checkout (10 largest files all named after genuine game/security proofs, e.g. HashSigTest/SLHDSA/SchemeWitnesses.lean 89918 bytes, VCVio/CryptoFoundations/Fischlin/Completeness.lean 79190 bytes) -- no anomalously large generated-data-table or dump-like file found.
